source.title: More Junk for Ziri
source.description: You've found another G-7 C.O.R.E. Processor. This unit looks to be in worse shape than the last one, and is leaking a very caustic looking inky black fluid. It's probably junk at this point, but Ziri might have a use for it.
source.objective: Talk with Ziri "The Wrench" Littlesprocket in Gnomeregan.
source.completion: Oh wow! A G-7 C.O.R.E. Processor. I don't think  I've ever actually seen one in person before. You should probably just throw that away. I've heard they are really dangerous.
